body: Leather gloves sit inside a knotted trash sack. Mustard-colored crop dust coats the cuffs. The outside of the sack is clean.
title: Gloves in a trash bag

body: They left in a hurry when a patrol announced this area was clear. One of them went back for a coat, and the patrol told her no one had been here since morning. The date on the coat label was today.
title: Notepad page
